targetCareer.description: Information Security Analysts plan, engineer, implement, and monitor security measures to protect computer networks, cloud systems, and critical national infrastructure. They conduct vulnerability assessments, simulate adversary cyberattacks through threat modeling, configure zero-trust access controls, and respond to security breaches to ensure system resilience and data confidentiality.

industryObstaclesAndMitigations.obstacle: Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Transition & Legacy Protocol Obsolescence
industryObstaclesAndMitigations.challenge: Quantum computing advances threaten current asymmetric public-key cryptography (RSA, ECC, Diffie-Hellman), creating vulnerability to 'harvest now, decrypt later' adversary tactics against federal data.
industryObstaclesAndMitigations.mitigation: Proactive research into NIST-standardized post-quantum algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA). Andrew explored cryptographic fundamentals through his CS646 Sanctum 3D engine, mastering lattice-based cryptography principles and hybrid TLS encapsulation mechanisms.

industryObstaclesAndMitigations.obstacle: Agentic AI Weaponization & Autonomous Adversary Exploits
industryObstaclesAndMitigations.challenge: Hostile state actors and cyber syndicates are weaponizing autonomous LLM agents to execute automated vulnerability discovery, multi-stage phishing, and real-time evasion of static security rules.
industryObstaclesAndMitigations.mitigation: Building zero-trust agentic security architectures. Andrew engineered 'Citadel' (Java 21 / Model Context Protocol) enforcing sandboxed tool invocation, strict capability manifests, and hardware-isolated local AI inference (MaqkrsTutor2) that neutralizes data egress risks.

industryObstaclesAndMitigations.obstacle: Critical National Infrastructure Ransomware & Zero-Trust Modernization
industryObstaclesAndMitigations.challenge: Legacy industrial control systems (ICS/SCADA) and municipal networks operate with outdated perimeter-only security models, making them vulnerable to lateral adversary movement following initial compromise.
industryObstaclesAndMitigations.mitigation: Deploying defense-in-depth and STRIDE threat modeling. Andrew's background in pharmaceutical cGMP compliance and industrial standard operating procedures (SOPs) bridges cyber controls with physical systems, enforcing strict micro-segmentation, multi-factor authentication, and immutable audit logs.
